title: Iterated fan-out expansion
statement: Given a natural number $n$ and a list of gates, start with the empty gate list, the identity map on natural numbers, and counter $n$, then process the gates in order by applying the single-gate fan-out expansion step with parameter $n$. The resulting state is the iterated fan-out expansion of the list.
